title: Research session view UI, connection/session data flow, and host RPC capabilities
Plan session history and path explorer implementation

content: Starting research into project structure, existing session view, connection flow, and any host APIs that can support directory browsing/session history.

observation: The MVP already has a mobile connection screen, session screen, optional bearer-token auth, host session list/open APIs, and direct LAN/Tailscale workflow; current mobile limitations include no persistent mobile host registry or QR pairing.

ConnectionScreen currently centers two panels with host URL/token inputs and a manual absolute workspace path input. It has no recent host/session history, no host session list UI, and no path explorer. Adding more mobile content should make this screen scrollable.

App view state stores hostUrl, token, cwd, prompt, connectionState, hostStatus, and errorMessage. On successful connect, cwd is seeded from HostStatus.cwd unless the existing value is already an absolute host path.

HostClient already supports status(), listSessions(cwd), openSession({cwd, sessionFile, mode}), prompt/steer/follow-up/abort, and WebSocket events with optional token auth. It has no directory browsing method yet.

OpenSessionRequest can open a new session by cwd or a previous persisted session with sessionFile/mode. SessionSummary/SessionState include id, cwd, title, sessionFile, runState, messageCount, and updatedAt, which are enough to save recent session history on the mobile client.

The host server routes authenticated GET /api/host/status, GET /api/sessions?cwd=, POST /api/sessions, session snapshot/events, commands, and extension UI responses. Adding a directory explorer can follow the same authenticated GET route pattern.

HostController currently normalizes session cwd/sessionFile through node:path and delegates list/open session operations. It can own a simple directory-list API using node:fs/os/path without involving the Pi SDK runtime.

The SDK runtime opens persisted Pi sessions through SessionManager.open(sessionFile, undefined, cwd), so exact reopening from a saved client session should preserve sessionFile when available; session id alone may need resolving via listSessions(cwd).

Prior MVP/review work established the TUI-like mobile style: dark background, monospaced text, compact cards, cyan/purple/yellow accents, and simple mobile-first panels. Recent UI changes also favor scroll/keyboard-aware layouts and compact buttons.

content: Research complete. The existing host already supports optional token auth and stored session listing/opening; mobile lacks any persistent history or path explorer. Exact previous-session reopening should save sessionFile when available and can resolve by saved session id via host listSessions(cwd) if needed. A simple authenticated directory listing endpoint can be added to the host.
Planning implementation steps and checking for blockers before code changes.

title: Add host directory listing protocol/API with tests
Add mobile client history persistence helpers and dependency with tests
Extend HostClient directory/session helpers with tests
Update the mobile connection screen with recent hosts, recent sessions, and path explorer UI

observation: No human clarification is required. Keep the token input because the host already implements optional bearer-token auth. Implement a minimal host directory API starting at '~', persist recent hosts/sessions in mobile AsyncStorage, save sessionFile in addition to the requested host/cwd/sessionId tuple for exact reopening, and keep the connection UI TUI-like but make it scrollable for mobile.

content: Implementation checklist added: host directory API, mobile history persistence, HostClient method/tests, connection screen UI, README, and validation. No blockers remain.

Starting host-side directory explorer work: add shared DirectoryList types, HostController directory listing, authenticated server route, and host tests for filtering/sorting directories and HTTP response shape.

observation: Host tests pass after adding the directory listing endpoint: 4 files, 15 tests.

content: Added DirectoryEntry/DirectoryList shared types, HostController.listDirectories() resolving '~' to the host home directory and returning sorted child directories only, and GET /api/directories. Added host-controller/server tests for directory filtering/HTTP response, and host tests pass.
Starting mobile client history work. Will add AsyncStorage as the native persistence dependency and a pure tested history helper for recent host/session dedupe, ordering, limits, and storage parsing.

observation: Added @react-native-async-storage/async-storage 3.0.2 to the mobile app for native client-side persistence; pnpm updated the lockfile and repeated existing ignored build-script warnings.
Mobile tests pass after adding client-history helpers: 5 files, 30 tests.

content: Added AsyncStorage dependency and a pure client-history module for loading/saving recent host and session history. History normalizes host URLs, dedupes by host or host/cwd/sessionId, saves sessionFile when available, and limits entries to eight. Added tests for normalization, dedupe, limits, malformed storage, and round-trip persistence.
Starting HostClient updates for directory browsing and previous-session reopening support from the mobile UI.

observation: Mobile tests pass after adding HostClient.listDirectories(): 5 files, 31 tests.

content: Added HostClient.listDirectories(path='~') with URL encoding and a mobile unit test covering the request URL/response parsing.

Starting the connection/session view UI update. This will wire AsyncStorage-backed history into App, make the connection screen scrollable, add recent host/session panels, add a directory explorer, and support opening either new sessions at saved paths or previous persisted sessions.

observation: Mobile TypeScript typecheck passes after wiring the connection screen to DirectoryList from shared. Shared must be built first because the app consumes @pi-mobile/shared via its dist export.
Mobile tests pass after adding setError and the connection-screen/history/path-explorer wiring: 5 files, 32 tests.

content: Updated App.tsx to load/save AsyncStorage client history, remember connected hosts and opened sessions, connect/open directly from recent host/session rows, open previous sessions using saved sessionFile or host listSessions(cwd), and browse directories from '~'. Reworked the connection screen into a scrollable mobile-first TUI-like layout with recent hosts, recent sessions, workspace, and path explorer panels. Kept the token field because optional bearer-token auth exists.
Updating README to document recent host/session history, path explorer usage, and the new /api/directories endpoint.

README now documents client-side recent host/session history, path explorer flow starting from '~', previous-session reopening, and the new GET /api/directories endpoint. Updated the limitations to say QR pairing is still absent but local recent history exists.
Starting final validation: full typecheck/test/build/coverage/export, whitespace check, and a mobile web smoke if the app/host can be served.
